text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final week of summer camp. The day after tomorrow,
we'll be heading back to the academy as well.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... phew~~!
Three beach sprints, complete!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer,
once tomorrow's training menu is done—
choice_data_list: ...Of course, let's pick up where that story left off.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ――! Please do!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Please excuse my behavior the other day, Trainer.
...I got far too emotional.
choice_data_list: No, I'm the one who should apologize...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I heard you had a talk with
Tsurumaru-san after that.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
And if she chooses to walk that path
with full conviction...
choice_data_list: When that time comes, I'll cheer for whoever she is then.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
......Yes.
I shall do the same.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow night is the final night of the training camp.
By then, we must settle the matter of Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's future."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case,
whether she keeps struggling or chooses to let go...
I pray she is left with no regrets.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock knock)
—Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I reached out to the person I had contacted beforehand,
asking if I could still have all of tomorrow as promised.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Huh, Trainer isn't here.
That's rare. You're usually here 5 minutes early.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"...Sensei isn't here either.
Did I get the meeting time wrong?"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~?
But it said "meet at the front entrance at 7:00 AM"...
Good morning, Tsuyoshi.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: President...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
W-Wah! Good morning!!
Are you working already this early, President!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No. Today's chores were taken off my hands
by a rather eccentric soul.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Tsuyoshi, I am your partner today!
Fortunately, the weather is perfect for an outing!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Do you like camping?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Tsuyoshi, let's feed the tent poles through.
I need your careful assistance, from start to finish.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. This will be our base for today.
What do you want to eat for lunch, Tsuyoshi?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: U-Um—I can eat anything!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, chew your food more thoroughly.
There's plenty grilled, so there's no need to rush.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Pwesident, it'sh so good!!
It'sh delicish!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see, it's delicious, is it?
After lunch, let's enjoy a quiet moment and go fishing.
I've already obtained permission.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —*Gulp!* Fishing with the President!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
E-Everyone's backing away! They're pulling back!
President~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha. Let's conquer our fears and fight bravely.
There, pull the rod up! Tsuyoshi!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(I was surprised when the President was there, but...
Spending time with the person I look up to felt like a dream.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (It's so fun! ...So much fun!!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (I realized that Trainer had been pulling strings behind the scenes for me.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (To bid farewell to a childish longing.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (—To turn my yearning into a "cherished memory"!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whooosh... whoosh...)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Right, time to pack up.
Did you get the tent into the bag?"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yes! And so—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Thank you as well, Madam President.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (I have to say it.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Even though my body is so weak...
It's all thanks to the President that I've
been able to keep trying my best!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (Say it.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I want to be like the President.
I want to be "absolutely strong" just like her!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ever since way before I entered the academy!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (Saying goodbye even to what I love.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Empowered by the President's running!
Encouraged by the "absolute" she demonstrated!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'll become an Uma Musume who makes the impossible certain, too...!
I swear I'll get stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...! But!
There was no "absolute" for me!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"So stop pretending not to see it!
If we don't have it, we just have to do our best without it!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
If I'm not an Umamusume with a guaranteed, "absolute" future like the President,
then I'll just have to fight in my own way—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —I don't hold such 'absolutes' either, Tsuyoshi.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There's no such thing as an "absolute"
that decides what the future will be.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: That can't be possible.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Now, everyone's saying it.
'Even if there are no "absolutes" in racing,
there is an "absolute" in Rudolf.'"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "I think so too! That's why up until now—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
“If such an ‘absolute’ truly existed,
I never would have lost even once, you know.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …………――Tsuyoshi.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You say you watched my race,
so you should already know.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: My first Japan Cup, as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
On that day, I lost to Katsuragi Ace.
That is an immutable, undeniable fact.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...And yet, why is it that you
saw an "absolute" in me?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: T-That is—...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
“But after that!
President, you beat Katsuragi Ace
in the Arima Kinen that very year!”

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Not just against Katsuragi Ace-san!
The President never stayed beaten against any opponent!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
She fought back and won against every opponent!
She proved that the President is stronger than any other Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Even so, for me,
there is no such thing as the "absolute" you speak of.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I were to enter races again
and run against Katsuragi Ace, what would happen?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"No, the potential matchups are limitless.
What would happen if she ran against the Triple Crown Umamusume Narita Brian, or the 'Monster' Maruzensky?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Some people are bound to start saying it.
That no one knows for sure
if Symboli Rudolf will win."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: No... but still...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Still...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
“—Even so, if you are truly convinced
that an 'absolute' exists within me.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Why do you feel that way?
The person who can give you that answer
...sadly, isn't me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to know, you should go.
Not to the figure of your admiration far ahead,
but to the one who has watched you closest by your side.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The answer lies sleeping right there.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Right next to me...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Go, Tsuyoshi.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If you say you've stopped turning a blind eye, then run.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Your legs are already itching to run, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...President.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Go!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That's it, Tsuyoshi.
Just like that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—The "absolute" you believed in
does not exist in the future.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What is "absolute"—
